title: Jonah and the Plant
reflectionText: A vine came up in a night and perished in a night, and Jonah cared more for its shade than for a city of a hundred twenty thousand. Twice God asked whether his anger was right. The book ends before Jonah answers. What is it to be left holding a question like that one?
editorialNotes: PAL Daily supervised production 2026-08-01, Batch I. Owner-approved anchor Jonah 4, whole chapter, no verses excluded. Written as the CODA to 1100 (Jonah 3, Nineveh repents), not as a middle beat: the single opening clause 'The city was spared' is neutral connective narration re-anchoring the referent of verse 1's 'it' for a listener, and the repentance of Nineveh is not re-told. Ends on God's question, unanswered, as the chapter does. WEB 'vine' and 'Yahweh'; KJV 'gourd' and 'the Lord'. Journey backlog item G16. TEXT DRAFT - AWAITING ADAM AND CHATGPT REVIEW. No audio.
